description.name: Liftoff
description.text: Six single attacks (3.05 each), grants [High Quick Cast 1] to the user

description.name: Boom-Boom Ultima
description.text: One single attack (16.40) capped at 99999, grants [Dark, Poison Ability +30% Boost 1] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode III (Dark, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Dark 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Poison 2 with Stacking] after using a Dark/Poison ability

description.name: Mental Collapse Mode
description.text: Casts Hyperdrive Kick when any Damage Reduction Barrier is removed, removed after triggering five times or if the character hasn't [Synchro Mode]

description.name: 40% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 40% for the next attack

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands
